Title: Cart Merge - A Guest Session Cannot Merge a Signed-In Customer's Cart (API, mergeCart Unauthorized)
Preconditions: Browser lane, storefront GraphQL proxy {{FRONT_URL}}/graphql called from the page (browser_evaluate / fetch). The anonymous caller cannot be expressed in the GraphQL runner (an [AUTH role=] line is required to acquire a token and none can drop it mid-case), so this case lives in the browser lane. The victim cart is a NAMED AGENT-TEST- cart of USER2 created in-case; no default cart is touched. Catches: VCST-6185 (pre-fix an anonymous caller merged another customer's cart and deleted it).
Test_Data: url={{FRONT_URL}}; user={{USER2_EMAIL}}; password={{USER2_PASSWORD}}; victim_cart=AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-VICTIM; anon_target_cart=AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-ANONTARGET; product=live-discover (first in-stock product of the B2B virtual catalog)
Steps:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[NAV] open {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[ACT] sign in as USER2 with the password typed by NAME (USER2_PASSWORD)
[API] from the page POST {{FRONT_URL}}/graphql: me { id } -> capture VICTIM_USER_ID; discover one in-stock product id -> PRODUCT_ID
[API] from the page POST addItem(command: { cartName: "AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-VICTIM", storeId, userId: VICTIM_USER_ID, productId: PRODUCT_ID, quantity: 1 }) { id itemsCount } -> capture VICTIM_CART_ID
[ACT] sign out through the storefront UI (the session is now anonymous)
[API] read the anonymous session's own user id from the storefront's own cart request ([NETWORK] cart query after sign-out) -> ANON_USER_ID
[API] POST {{FRONT_URL}}/graphql WITHOUT an Authorization header and with cookies omitted: mergeCart(command: { storeId, userId: ANON_USER_ID, cartName: "AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-ANONTARGET", currencyCode: "USD", cultureName: "en-US", secondCartId: VICTIM_CART_ID, deleteAfterMerge: true }) { id itemsCount }
[NAV] open {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[ACT] sign in as USER2 again
[API] POST cart(storeId, userId: VICTIM_USER_ID, currencyCode: "USD", cartName: "AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-VICTIM") { id itemsCount items { productId quantity } }
[API] POST removeCart(command: { cartId: VICTIM_CART_ID, userId: VICTIM_USER_ID })
[ACT] sign out
Assertions:
[API] the mergeCart response is HTTP 200 with data.mergeCart = null and errors[0].extensions.code = Unauthorized {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
[STATE] the victim cart still exists after the call: id = VICTIM_CART_ID, itemsCount = 1, the item is PRODUCT_ID with quantity 1 {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
[API] the anonymous target cart gained nothing: no line with PRODUCT_ID {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
[API] the addItem and removeCart setup mutations return errors[] empty {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
[NETWORK] no 5xx on /graphql during the case {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no new JS errors beyond the storefront's known image/service-worker 404s
[EVIDENCE] errors[0].message carries no cart contents, owner id or stack trace
Failure_Signals: errors[] empty on the anonymous mergeCart (the guest merged a signed-in customer's cart — VCST-6185); the victim cart gone or its item missing after the call; the victim's product present in the anonymous target; any 5xx
Cleanup: removeCart on the victim cart (last API step); the anonymous target cart is never created when the merge is refused, but a leftover AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-ANONTARGET is swept by the AGENT-TEST- teardown; sign out and clear the session

Title: Cart Merge - A Signed-In Customer Can Still Merge a Guest Cart Explicitly by secondCartId (isAnonymous exemption)
Preconditions: Browser lane, storefront GraphQL proxy called from the page. Positive control for the VCST-6185 fix: a guest cart (server-set isAnonymous) is exempt from the cart-access check, so an authorization fix that is too strict would break it. The sign-in merge itself (CART-100) may run server-side and not exercise this path (KB-B4490B0B), hence the explicit call. Named AGENT-TEST- carts only. Catches: VCST-6185 (over-reach regression guard).
Test_Data: url={{FRONT_URL}}; user={{USER2_EMAIL}}; password={{USER2_PASSWORD}}; guest_cart=AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-GUEST; target_cart=AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-TARGET; product=live-discover (first in-stock product of the B2B virtual catalog)
Steps:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[NAV] open {{FRONT_URL}} as a guest
[API] from the page POST addItem(command: { cartName: "AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-GUEST", storeId, userId: ANON_USER_ID (the guest session's own id), productId: PRODUCT_ID, quantity: 1 }) { id itemsCount } -> capture GUEST_CART_ID
[NAV] open {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[ACT] sign in as USER2 with the password typed by NAME (USER2_PASSWORD)
[API] POST me { id } -> USER2_ID; addItem into a NAMED target cart "AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-TARGET" with a second, different product -> TARGET_CART_ID
[API] POST mergeCart(command: { storeId, userId: USER2_ID, cartName: "AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-TARGET", currencyCode: "USD", cultureName: "en-US", secondCartId: GUEST_CART_ID, deleteAfterMerge: true }) { id itemsCount items { productId quantity } }
[API] POST cart(... cartName: "AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-GUEST") { id }
[API] POST removeCart(command: { cartId: TARGET_CART_ID, userId: USER2_ID })
[ACT] sign out
Assertions:
[API] mergeCart returns no errors[] {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
[STATE] the merged target carries both products: the guest cart's product and the target's own product {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
[STATE] the guest cart no longer resolves after the merge (deleteAfterMerge true) {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
[API] the addItem and removeCart setup mutations return errors[] empty {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
[NETWORK] no 5xx on /graphql during the case {SPEC} (VCST-6185)
Cross_Layer_Checks: [CONSOLE] no new JS errors beyond known storefront 404s
Failure_Signals: Forbidden or Unauthorized on the guest cart (the fix also locks out guest carts — breaks guest-to-account merge); guest product missing in the merged target; guest cart still present
Cleanup: removeCart on the target (last API step); the guest cart is consumed by the merge, leftover AGENT-TEST-MERGEAUTH-GUEST swept by the AGENT-TEST- teardown; sign out
